scientific_integrity: The disproof is analytic and exact. Orthogonal projections give closed formulas for the pedal radii, and the explicit interior excess is proved positive using rational lower bounds for the two radicals. Numerical output is supplemental only.
scientific_limitations: The result disproves the universal linear conjecture and proves an open boundary layer of counterexamples for one fixed isosceles triangle; it does not classify the full validity region or determine an optimal replacement coefficient. Unindexed prior literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: A boundary-layer counterfamily to Liu's pedal-radius Conjecture 1
